title: Universal Monsters: Frankenstein Black & White Special #1
desc: FRANKENSTEIN LIVES AGAIN IN SILVER SCREEN BLACK & WHITE! Award-winning creator MICHAEL WALSH (EXQUISITE CORPSES) presents the first two issues of his jaw-dropping new vision of the seminal horror classic remastered in stunning black & white. Dr. Henry Frankenstein begins his unholy quest to create life by robbing the grave of a decorated police officer to find necessary parts, specifically a strong pair of hands. But little does he know that the corpse has a son who is mourning a father—and that this young boy will forever change Frankenstein’s life.
